rows.text: Now there's a warrior I've never seen before... Pretty cute, too... I like it...
rows.speaker: Goldenfly

rows.text: Babe, you are a talking butterfly...
It's obvious that you're not a real human!
Wow~ You actually saw straight through my disguise. Don't tell me you're my lady's priest, are you? I haven't seen them in a long time...
rows.speaker: Goldenfly

rows.text: What a shame! If you were also nymphs, we could have had a lot of fun together.
rows.speaker: Goldenfly
